protected_route_contract.purpose: Canonical React mechanism for gating routes by role/capability (resolves OI-36 routing documentation; depends on useRole)
protected_route_contract.status: ACTIVE — shipped v10.499 Stage C Batch 2e
protected_route_contract.consumed_by: App.tsx route table — wraps the `element` prop of React Router `<Route>` declarations

props.children: ReactNode — the protected content rendered when authorization succeeds
props.requireAnyRole: string[] (optional) — user.role matches one of the provided role names, case-insensitive

protected_route_contract.semantics: All requirement props are optional. When multiple are provided, they combine with AND semantics — the user must satisfy every stated requirement. requireAuth is implicit when any other requirement is set (an unauthenticated user cannot be admin).

state_rendering.loading: null (blank during sub-second fetch — avoids flashing unauth message)
state_rendering.unauthenticated: 'Please log in' message (v1 placeholder; real redirect when AuthProvider becomes real)
state_rendering.unauthorized: 'Access denied' message with specific failed-requirement reason

smoke_test_integration_batch_2e.current_behavior: Renders 'Please log in' because AuthProvider is still a stub and no JWT cookie is set; when real auth lands, same wrap produces real Dashboard render automatically with no further code changes
smoke_test_integration_batch_2e.rationale_for_partial_wrap: Only / is wrapped for end-to-end proof. Other routes will be wrapped individually when each page reaches production-readiness and its access requirements are decided.

v1_limitations_intentional: Unauthenticated state shows a message, not a redirect — real redirect to /login lands when AuthProvider becomes real (depends on v10.497 milestone)
Inline error-state styling (`style={{ padding: '2rem', textAlign: 'center' }}`) — production polish would use bespoke v10.496 Card primitive (tracked as OI-65)
No requireSbu or requireBranchScope props yet — only tier and role-name predicates ship in v1; SBU/scope predicates are a 5-line additive change when first consumer demands them

gate_no_raw_role_gates_in_routes (HIGH): routes use <ProtectedRoute> with prop-based gates, not inline conditionals or direct role-string comparisons
